reference.solarModel: SolarPosition.swift equations transcribed for offline arithmetic; unmodified engine
reference.lunarModel: Astronomy Engine GeoMoon/Equator; airless topocentric coordinates; phase/limb from topocentric Sun–Moon geometry
reference.moonRiseSetConvention: Topocentric geometric center altitude + 34/60 degrees + physical angular radius = 0; no horizon dip
